angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Differential education helps fast learners stay interested.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Differential education helps fast learners stay interested.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Differential education supports slow learners who need more time.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Differential education supports slow learners who need more time.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Differential education can make students feel bad and lose interest.

angles.en: Differential education can make the learning experience unfair and prevent students from helping each other.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Students receive instruction tailored to their academic pace, allowing fast learners to advance and slow learners to get extra help, thereby reducing the learning gap.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Students receive instruction tailored to their academic pace, allowing fast learners to advance and slow learners to get extra help, thereby reducing the learning gap.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Small group settings enable teachers to provide personalized attention, allowing them to identify and address specific student struggles, which boosts confidence and understanding.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Small group settings enable teachers to provide personalized attention, allowing them to identify and address specific student struggles, which boosts confidence and understanding.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Differential education can cause students to feel judged by their academic ability, potentially lowering their self-confidence and motivation.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The system might restrict the learning experience by offering a curriculum that is too narrow, preventing advanced students from challenging themselves with broader topics.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The system might restrict the learning experience by offering a curriculum that is too narrow, preventing advanced students from challenging themselves with broader topics.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of differential education by splitting students into different classes based on academic performance.
keyArguments: Differential education allows for tailored teaching methods that cater to individual learning paces and academic abilities.
However, it can lead to a lack of inclusivity and may disadvantage students who struggle to keep up in faster-paced environments.
